name: run_blender_script
title: run_blender_script
description: Runs a Blender Python (bpy) script headless and imports whatever it exports. Free. This is the procedural-geometry path, and it is worth being honest about what it is good for: generated bpy code produces good PARAMETRIC geometry — walls, floors, stairs, railings, platforms, modular kit pieces, anything describable as boxes and extrusions — and poor organic geometry. Do not try to model a character or a weapon this way; use generate_3d_asset for those. Your script receives '--output <abs path>' after a bare '--' when you pass the 'output' parameter, and should export there. Print a line starting with GODOT_AI_OS_RESULT followed by JSON to report structured results back.

source.description: The complete bpy script. It runs with --factory-startup, so no user addons are loaded and the scene starts empty.

output.description: Where the script should export. Passed to the script as --output; the file is imported afterwards.

written.description: False means the script ran cleanly but exported nothing.

output_tail.description: Last of Blender's stdout, for debugging.

report.description: Parsed from a GODOT_AI_OS_RESULT line, if the script printed one.

errors.blender_not_found: Blender is not installed or not findable.
errors.blender_failed: The script raised; details.output_tail has the traceback.
